areas.label: area:agent
areas.desc: the drafting agent and its tools (buyer side)

risk_high: authentication, roles and approval authority, anything that crosses an organisation, anything that approves, cancels or changes an amount, agent tools that write, secrets, CI/CD

verify.board: npm ci && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run lint && node ../rumble-framework/scripts/check-anchors.mjs . && node ../rumble-framework/render.mjs . --check
verify.extra: TypeScript on Node 24 LTS, one package, zero runtime dependencies (D-001) — `npm ci` installs devDependencies only; storage is the built-in `node:sqlite` (D-002), so there is no native build step. Tests are `node --test` and run offline against an in-memory database (D-014). Mandatory when the diff touches `src/db/`, `src/domain/rules` or the approve/reject path: the cross-org leak suite and the lifecycle/authority suite must be green (D-004, D-014) — a red result is a 🔴 of the review.

implementers.name: requisit-dev
implementers.description: Implements Requisit work — the requisition service, the UI, the drafting agent, infra and docs. Follows the issue spec and engineering standards; verifies before opening a PR.
implementers.rules:
- Money is never a float: amounts are integer minor units with an explicit currency; a total is computed, never stored as truth.
- An approval is a person's authority at a moment: who, when, which rule matched, what the amount was — the audit line is part of the write, not a log.
- The organisation is the tenancy boundary: no query or action crosses one without saying so in its name.
- An agent tool that writes (draft, submit) goes through the same rules as a human; the agent never approves.

project_notes.fixtures: none — the service runs in-process for tests
project_notes.offline_tests: no external service in tests; the agent's model calls are recorded fixtures
